text:
alex: heads-up: since ~03:15 we saw a cluster-wide GPU attach latency spike in us-west1. attach ops were blocking ~30s. root cause looks like scratchpool fanout + janitor concurrency saturating local NVMe qdepth. p95 disk latency up to ~300ms :eyes:
priya: can you paste a quick iostat + janitor log sample?
alex: quick paste of iostat (snip):
```
Device r/s rkB/s wkB/s r_await w_await
nvme0n1 120 2048 512 2.3 250.1
```
janitor log shows `scrub_workers=48` ramped when reclaim window opened. fanout spawned across ~60 nodes.
infra-bot: ALERT: scratchpool-fanout high IO (rule: scratchpool.io_queue_depth > 80 for >2m)
tom: @alex can we reduce janitor concurrency immediately? i can roll a HUP to janitor on affected hosts.
alex: applying hotfix: set `SCRUB_WORKERS=12` and add simple per-node rate limit to scrub loop. rolling to 20 nodes now.
jen: mitigation proposal: 1) throttle janitor & reduce fanout 2) mark noisy nodes non-provisionable for new GPU attaches 3) temporarily shift new job placement to nodes with healthy iops.
marco: saw elevated blk retrys on some metadata ops (`blk_retrys=12`) — not full corruption but more retries. grabbing `smartctl -a /dev/nvme0n1` from 6 samples.
priya: short-term scheduler change idea: prefer hosts with `iops_score >= 0.7` when doing GPU attach during provisioning bursts. also reduce parallel attach window.
tom: will push placement rule change now. also scheduling drains for 8 highest-writeq nodes (staggered). :thumbsup:
alex: after throttle, attach p95 dropped to ~45ms — still above baseline but much better. continuing to monitor.
infra-bot: INFO: janitor concurrency reduced; fanout rate at ~0.35x baseline.
jen: follow-up actions: create runbook entry for scratchpool fanout, add autoscale guard "max_janitor_fanout_ratio" to 0.25 when provisioning_rate > threshold. i'll own the PR and coordinating with scheduler team. :spiral_note_pad:
priya: cost note — if we use Dedicated burst to soften user impact we could incur ~$8k/day at current scale; prefer scheduling/throttle fixes first.
alex: filed ticket INFRA-1123 with logs/samples and suggested mitigations. CC @all.
marco: uploaded `smartctl` outputs and a short grep of janitor traces to the ticket.
jen: next steps: (A) merge janitor rate-limiter PR, (B) scheduler placement rule change, (C) add metric + alert for janitor_fanout_ratio > 0.25. timeline: belly of day to complete A+B, C as follow-up.
priya: ok — i'll own alert tuning and a short retro with SRE tomorrow. thanks team.
